summary: Backend core flows passed. Frontend login and dashboard load, but navigating from dashboard to Dudas triggers a React runtime error and blocks subsequent MVP flows.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigation triggers runtime error `destroy is not a function`; page never renders. `useEffect(load, [])` and equivalent async arrow effects return Axios promises, which React treats as cleanup functions.

integration_issues.flow: Sidebar navigation and all downstream flows
integration_issues.issue: Dudas navigation crashes before question creation; advisory booking, chat, and AI were not reachable in the same run.

action_items: Wrap async page loaders inside useEffect callbacks that do not return the Axios promise, and add catch/error states for page API calls; retest all navigation and CRUD flows.
critical_code_review_comments: React effects in Questions, Subjects, and Advisories return promises directly; cleanup must be a function or undefined. This is the root cause of the runtime crash.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_regression_question and one TEST chat message through public APIs; no cleanup endpoint exists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo login and dashboard pass at desktop and 320px mobile. Desktop navigation to Dudas reproduces runtime error. Mobile dashboard screenshot showed no horizontal overflow; sidebar user selector is hidden on mobile by design. Google OAuth is HONESTLY MOCKED as a configuration-status message; chat realtime is MOCKED via 5-second polling. AI was not reached due to navigation crash.
rca of the issue: In App.js, `useEffect(load, [])` where load returns `api.get(...).then(...)` causes React to store a Promise as destroy cleanup. On route unmount React calls destroy and throws `destroy is not a function`. The same pattern appears in Questions, Subjects, and Advisories.
